title: Masseter, temporalis and the jaw line

queue.claim: Relaxed masseter thickness per side is 9.8 ± 1.3 mm in women and 11.3 ± 1.2 mm in men (12.4 and 14.7 clenched; Korean young adults). A systematic review gives 10-15 mm relaxed and 14-19 mm contracted for men. These values set the default masseter prior (F N(10,1.8²), M N(12,2²)) and the clench gain κ≈0.28.

queue.claim: Skeletal priors from expert knowledge: gonial angle ≈ N(122°, 7°), normal 110-135°; bony bigonial width M ≈ 90-105 mm (N(97,6²)) and F ≈ 84-97 mm (N(90,5²)); go-go/zy-zy ratio ≈ 0.70-0.80.

queue.claim: Facial soft-tissue depth, skin to bone, is ≈ 8-18 mm at gonion and ≈ 14-26 mm at mid-ramus over the masseter; the temple is ≈ 9-18 mm.

queue.claim: In the Taiwanese automated-segmentation study, temporalis volume peaks at 36.9 mL (men, age 20-29) and 27.9 mL (women, age 30-39), then declines 38% and 60%. Whether these volumes are per side is unconfirmed. The age slope of the temple prior (≈0.6%/yr in men, 1%/yr in women) is derived from them.
